== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for BoShek: the entry “BoShek” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'' Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 28. Image for [[BoShek (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]]; archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652].
